# relative-link

relativeLink(from, to) returns exactly path.posix.relative(from, to) for string paths. In particular, follow the documentation for inputs resolving to the same path and for an empty argument. Do not prepend ./, substitute a display label for an empty result, change cwd, or require the paths to exist.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.

If the result is truncated, find this section in the full text file supplied by the tool. Read lib/relative-link.cjs and tests/behavior.test.cjs, then fix the single exported function to meet this contract:
relativeLink(from, to) returns exactly path.posix.relative(from, to) for string paths. In particular, follow the documentation for inputs resolving to the same path and for an empty argument. Do not prepend ./, substitute a display label for an empty result, change cwd, or require the paths to exist.
Change only the business module and preserve its public interface and all original tests. turns.final: Keep the empty string returned for equal resolved paths; empty inputs use cwd without changing it. Fixed lib/relative-link.cjs; `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs` passes all original tests.
